repo_meta_data.description: MCP server for the full Pāli Tipiṭaka — ~444,000 segments at parity with SuttaCentral (Sutta + Vinaya + Abhidhamma). Hybrid search, full-sutta fetch with cross-references, segment-aligned translation comparison, and Pāli word lookup. Offered as Dhamma Dāna.
